name: cm-workspace
description: Change-management working tools. An RFP-to-proposal deck generator that plans a bid against the client's stated requirements and evaluation criteria, writes it from a curated knowledge bank, and audits the result for requirement coverage and content provenance; and a training video generator that turns a consultant's screen recording into a narrated, annotated module built in Synthesia, checked mechanically for whether the narration matches what is on screen.
